edgeText.text: Minecraft mods for Fabric and NeoForge. Every mod'
shows what has shipped and what is coming.

findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (34 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.3:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 144 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 32px (2.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Barlow Condensed and Barlow, but the page renders system-ui.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Chimeric Mods") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: Browser-default blue/purple link colour is showing.
findings.fix: Style every link: inherit the text colour and mark it with weight, underline offset, or the accent.
Fix the URL or replace the asset.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 8px from the left edge but only to 61px from the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: 7 sections keep all their content on one side and leave 54% of the width empty: "Artificial Heart" (right 393px empty); "Banner Tweaks" (right 326px empty); "ChimericLib" (right 328px empty); "Next Update Now" (right 360px empty)
findings.fix: Use the whole width the page has set up: put the section's picture, its second column, its list or its figure in the empty half, or set the text larger across the grid. Empty space must be placed, with something on each side of it.

findings.message: 6 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Chimeric Mods" (8px from the left); "Mods" (8px from the left); "GitHub" (8px from the left); "Chimeric Mods" (8px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
